1.explanation:
1. 'packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/Tabs.js': This is the main implementation file for the 'Line Tabs' variant. To support an icon-only variant, logic and styling updates are needed here to render tabs with only icons and to handle the new variant prop.
2. 'packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/ContainedTabs.js': This is the main implementation file for the 'ContainedTabs' variant. Similar to the above, it needs to support rendering icon-only tabs and handle the new variant.
3. 'packages/react/src/components/Tab/next/Tab.js': This file defines the individual Tab component used by both Tabs and ContainedTabs. It will need to be updated to accept and render icon-only content, possibly by supporting a new prop or rendering logic for icon-only tabs.

These three files are key because they define the structure, props, and rendering logic for the Tabs and Tab components, which must be updated to support the new icon-only variant as described in the bug report and shown in the images.
1.bug_scenario: The bug report requests the addition of an 'icon-only' variant for both 'Line Tabs' and 'ContainedTabs' components. The provided images illustrate the desired UI: tabs that display only icons (no text labels), with specific sizing and spacing (20px icon, 48px tab width). The scenario is about updating the Tabs components to support this new visual style and interaction pattern.
